card.name: The word per after times
card.fires_on: The word "per" right after a count such as "three times" or "6 times", before day or week in dosing frequency. It also fires on "a" in "once in a while".

modes.label: Times per day/week
modes.description: "per" after a number plus "times" in a dosing schedule, where day or week comes next.
modes.example: ase 1 tablet per meal • Starting dose is one or two 800 mg or two to four 400 mg tablets three times<< per>> day with meals. ( 2 )

modes.label: Once in a while
modes.description: The word "a" in the fixed phrase "once in a while" in casual prose.
modes.example: And there's not a thing wrong with that, once in<< a>> while. As Mom always said, "

card.writes: It favors words meaning a repeat count, like "twice" and "两次", which fits a frequency phrase.
card.plain: It lights up on "per" in phrases like "3 times per week" that state how often a dose is given.
